---
title: "Add data to your MAXQDA project"
---

You can add many different types of data to your MAXQDA project. When you open the Import menu, you'll see a list of options for different data types @fig-import

::: {#fig-import}
![Import menu in MAXQDA showcasing the options for uploading different types of data](/img/maxqda-import-bar.png)
:::

# Text data

::::: {layout="[ 30, 70 ]"}
::: {first-column}
Any text data files can be added to MAXQDA by using `Insert > Texts, PDFs, Tables` option. You'll be prompted to select the files you want to upload from your device (#1) and click `open` (#2).

If you have interview transcripts without time stamps, you can import these as text documents as well. @fig-upload-text shows importing interview transcripts without time stamps in Word documents.
:::

::: {#fig-upload-text}
![Selecting interview transcript files to upload to MAXQDA](/img/maxqda-select-files.png){fig-alt="user selecting a set of transcript files from the Mac finder"}
:::
:::::

You can also drag and drop files from your computer's file system into the document window of MAXQDA. I have noticed, however, that dragging a large number of files can cause errors.

## Existing highlights or comments in Word or PDF documents

If you upload Word or PDF documents that have existing highlighted portions or comments, those will be imported into your MAXQDA project along with the data files.

::: {#fig-highlight-codes}
![Example of codes created when uploaded Word or PDF documents with highlights.](/img/maxqda-highlight-code.png){fig-alt="Example of codes created in code system when highlighted documents are uploaded. The two codes in this example are labeled \"black\" and \"yellow\""}
:::

Highlighted sections will be coded with the color of the highlight, with MAXQDA creating a new code labeled with the color name. You can change the name of the color to a descriptive term if you would like.

Comments will be added and appear in the left side of the document.

# Transcripts with media and time stamps

If you have video or audio of interviews or focus groups, you may want to create transcripts that are linked to the media file via time stamps.
